meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.21.19;
father of: Meshullemeth (H4922)
§ Haruz = "zealous"
a man of Jotbah, father of Meshullemeth, wife of Manasseh and mother of Amon

elsewhere.note: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
